en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from one of his companions, raising it, said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who cultivates the enmity would reap what he sows’.
en.sarwar: 12. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from certain individuals of his people in a marfu’ manner the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Whoever plants animosity will reap what he has sown.’”
